_comment: Data-authored night deeds + event consequences (combat plan §M6), consumed by the generic DeedRunner autoload. A DEED is a witnessable act an agent performs when its schedule brings it to a waypoint during the named phases: the fact_line fans through the standard vision-gated Stimulus channel (no engine strings), and the player proxy SEEING it grants the clue. A CONSEQUENCE row reacts to a published combat event (`transformed` / agent_downed as `downed`) for the named agent: pressures adjust, and the clue lands — gated on the proxy's own sight when clue_needs_sight. All identity strings live HERE, never in engine code.

deeds.fact_line: Kell drags something heavy toward the canal.

deeds._note: M12 — the SECOND adversary's signature deed (sable_wren's 'wrongness', mirroring the butcher's canal round). Her schedule walks her to the Blackthorn corner at night/late-night; the deed FIRES once per day there, fanning the fact_line through the standard vision-gated Stimulus channel. The PLAYER PROXY seeing it grants sable_wren_suspicious — the suspicion clue that feeds the hunter_prey lead (same seam as kell_canal_disposal -> bram_kell_suspicious). All identity strings are DATA; DeedRunner knows no id.
deeds.fact_line: Sable Wren stalks a frightened stranger off the Blackthorn corner, patient as a thing that hunts.

deeds._note: M14 — the THIRD adversary's signature deed (leland_mack's 'wrongness', mirroring wren_blackthorn_stalk). His schedule walks him to the harbor breakwater at night/late-night; the deed FIRES once per day there, fanning the fact_line through the standard vision-gated Stimulus channel. The PLAYER PROXY seeing it grants leland_mack_suspicious — the suspicion clue that feeds the hunter_prey_mack_docks lead (same seam as kell_canal_disposal -> bram_kell_suspicious and wren_blackthorn_stalk -> sable_wren_suspicious). All identity strings are DATA; DeedRunner knows no id.
deeds.fact_line: Leland Mack hauls something heavy to the edge of the breakwater and tips it over — not fish.

deeds._note: M5 (direction v2 §6): the PLAYER's 'acting' ritual — stalk and act the predator, the role of the Hunter pathway. Unlike a schedule-walked NPC deed, this fires on demand when the player performs it (DeedRunner.perform_deed), which Progression requires before an advance. agent='player' so the actor is the proxy; no waypoint/phase gate (the player acts wherever they choose to digest).
deeds.fact_line: The investigator moves like something that hunts — reading trails, holding still, becoming the predator.

deeds._note: M28 (direction v2 §6): the HERMIT player's 'acting' ritual — trace the star-charts and work the knowing rite, the role of the Hermit pathway (mirrors the Hunter's hunter_act_predator). Fires on demand when the player performs it (DeedRunner.perform_deed), which Progression requires before a Hermit advance (Progression.acting_deed_id() returns this for pathway hermit). agent='player'; no waypoint/phase gate (the Hermit works the rite wherever they choose to digest).
deeds.fact_line: The investigator draws the star-charts and works the rite, reading the turning of the heavens like a true Hermit.

The PLAYER PROXY seeing it grants old_neil_suspicious — the suspicion clue that feeds the hermit_prey_neil lead (same seam as kell_canal_disposal -> bram_kell_suspicious). All identity strings are DATA; DeedRunner knows no id.
deeds.fact_line: Behind a shuttered window Old Neil bleeds himself into a chalk star and mouths a name the dark answers — Celeste.

deeds.fact_line: Deep in the stacks after closing, Ledger Finch reads aloud from a volume that should not exist, and the ink runs off the page toward her like it is listening.

deeds._note: M_death: the DEATH player's 'acting' ritual — keep the corpse-collector's office (canon: wash the dead, speak the words, listen for what answers). Mirrors hunter_act_predator/hermit_act_rite: fires on demand via DeedRunner.perform_deed, which Progression requires before a Death advance (ACTING_DEEDS['death']). agent='player'; no waypoint/phase gate.
deeds.fact_line: The investigator keeps the corpse-collector's office — washes the dead, speaks the burial words, and holds still for what answers.

deeds._note: M_death — sister_auber's signature deed (her 'wrongness', mirroring neil_star_rite). Her schedule holds her near Saint Selena's at night; the deed FIRES once per day there through the vision-gated Stimulus channel. The PLAYER PROXY seeing it grants sister_auber_suspicious — the suspicion clue that feeds the death_prey_auber lead. Waypoint = her night schedule slot [1700,5150]; radius 40 (NOT the neil/finch 80): her MORNING slot sits only 50px away, and combat_sim scenario D stages the roster at morning positions before running its pinned night fight — an 80px radius fires this deed into scenario D's byte-pinned event transcript. 40 keeps the live night behavior (she parks exactly on the slot) and keeps A-H byte-identical.
deeds.fact_line: Behind the almshouse, Sister Auber speaks the burial office over ground with no grave in it — and the ground answers her, politely, like a congregation.

deeds._note: M_death — brother_cassian's signature deed (mirroring finch_archive_rite). His schedule brings him to the cathedral at night; waypoint = his night slot. The proxy seeing it grants brother_cassian_suspicious — feeds the death_prey_cassian lead.
deeds.fact_line: Down the crypt stair past midnight, Brother Cassian sings a requiem to the standing dead — and the dead keep time.
